name: White Card (Residency for Digital Nomads)

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum net monthly income of EUR3,000, maintained for at least 6 months before entry and throughout the stay.
requirements.fix_path: Increase and document qualifying net monthly income to at least EUR3,000, sustained 6+ months.

requirements.blocker_text: Must have a verified employment relationship with an employer outside Hungary, performing the work remotely using advanced digital technology, OR hold shares in a profitable foreign company managed remotely from Hungary. Any Hungarian employment or Hungarian company stake disqualifies the applicant.

evidence_required.document: Proof of foreign employment relationship or foreign company shareholding
6 months of income documentation at or above the threshold
Health insurance (social security, international treaty, or proof of funds)
Accommodation proof (lease, ownership, courtesy statement, or paid reservation)

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, extendable once for 1 additional year (2 years total)

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- White Card: EUR3,000/month income test, foreign-employer-only eligibility, 1+1 year cap, family reunification prohibition

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Notably strict compared to some other countries' nomad-visa designs in this dataset: family reunification is fully prohibited (birth-in-Hungary is the sole exception), the permit is hard-capped at 2 years total with no further renewal, and there is no stated path to any settlement status. Any Hungarian-registered work or company stake -- including the very self-employment/business route modelled separately as hu_guest_self_employment -- is explicitly disqualifying for this permit; the two routes are mutually exclusive by design.
